connector.name: Browserbash
connector.registryDescription: Plain-English browser tests for AI agents: real Chrome, deterministic verdicts. Free, no API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package browserbash-cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pramoddutta account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key. Optional: without it BrowserBash auto-resolves a free local Ollama model.
